payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details on how the layer norm approximation affects performance, indicating a measurable reduction in task performance due to this approximation.

claims.text: The layer norm approximation incurs the most significant performance reduction, averaging 1.08% across tasks.
Jointly finetuning the softmax estimation model and approximated layernorm leads to performance drops across all tasks.
The approximation error tends to accumulate when the transformer has too many layers, negatively impacting performance.
